eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Consolidated sealing of more than one Nevada record held within this county under NRS 179.2595, with each underlying record screened against the section that governs it — NRS 179.245 for a conviction or NRS 179.255 where the proceedings did not result in a conviction
additionalFacts: Petitioner seeks to seal more than one record of criminal proceedings, and each record identified in this Petition is held within this county.
Each record identified in this Petition appears on the verified criminal history from the Nevada Central Repository submitted with this Petition.
Petitioner states the reasons supporting sealing in the accompanying declaration; that statement is completed by Petitioner and is not supplied by any other person.

attachments: Verified criminal history from the Nevada Central Repository
Affidavit or declaration in support (completed and signed by Petitioner)
Stipulation with a separate signature line for each prosecuting agency (signatures to be obtained)
